findings.passage: House Bill 1109 By: Representatives Byrd of the 20th, Kahaian of the 81st, Dunahoo of the 31st, and Barrett of the 24th
findings.motion: HB 1109, Elections; certain driver's licenses and identification cards shall not be proper identification
findings.note: She is one of four named sponsors. The bill amends Code Section 21-2-417 so that a driver's license or special ID card issued to a noncitizen is not proper ID to show a poll worker, and it would require licenses held by noncitizens to carry the words 'BEARER NOT A U.S. CITIZEN - NOT VOTER ID' and an 'NC' number prefix. Date is the first-reading date recorded by a bill tracker (policyrisk.com, fetched); the tracker shows the bill stopped at House Second Readers on 2026-02-03 and did not pass.
subjects: noncitizen driver's licenses as voter ID
